metadata.query: sonar visualization web app dark theme
metadata.method: vision_glance (gpt-5.5 via scripts/vision-call-file.sh, native tools 503) + vision_dominant_colors regions + pixel-exact BMP measurement (analyze-ui.py + targeted scans)

notes: Canvas #060B10 (measured page gutter #02070C-#070D12 with scanline/noise texture) is DARKER than the panels — inverse of typical dark dashboards.
Panel/card fill measured #121F23 (center), #161F26 (left column), #172129 (right column) — representative #141F26.

Widget title bands #18222A with a 1px brighter top rule #304C55 and pale-cyan uppercase tracked mono titles (measured modal #7AC0C7, bright #A9D6DC — parent-validated #8ED5DF sits inside this bracket).
Semantic greens: BTR recorder lines modal #07F00A / bright avg #03E877 (success); tactical contact markers are a distinct teal-green #22D083 used inside the sonar scope itself.
Amber modal #FACD78 (DEMON traces, status text); reds #E54344 (left column ping) / #D66566-#EB6D6E (right column buttons) — representative #E54344.
Waterfall blue-white modal #83DAFF, bright scan #74CEFF (info blue).
Bright turquoise #00E6D0 is the most prominent analytical accent on active traces/selected modes.

frame.notes: Page canvas is near-black blue #060B10 with fine horizontal scanlines + dotted noise; panels are separated by 4-8px gutters; each panel is a closed 1px #2C4853 rectangle (measured exact single-pixel runs at y=120 x=200 -> #304C55, x=396 y=650 -> #2C4853, x=1190 y=650 -> #2C4751). 0px radius everywhere. Title bands carry a slightly brighter top edge.

cards.notes: Per-widget card treatment: 1px #2C4853 full rectangle, 0 radius, fill #141F26; title strip fill #18222A (~24px) separated from content by a hairline, with a brighter cyan top-edge accent; small uppercase monospaced tracked titles in pale cyan. Subtle glow only on plot content (traces/markers), never on the card chrome itself.

dividers.notes: Thin darker hairlines (#1F2A32-#22323C) divide data groups, list rows, control areas and separate the title band from content.

inputs.notes: Square compact military-console controls: 1px #2C4853 outlines, dark fills ~#0F151E, small mono labels; selected/checked controls take the bright turquoise #00E6D0 or blue #74CEFF emphasis.

activeIndicators.notes: Active/selected items are marked by brighter cyan-teal top/edge emphasis (brighter top rule on title bands, selected mode buttons, active traces) rather than left accent bars.

regions.name: commandBar
regions.description: Full-width command bar (~12% height, y<108): station title SILENT ABYSS // TACTICAL centered, left maneuver controls, center propulsion controls, right visualization toggles + SONAR STATUS (PASSIVE MODE + mission timer). Fill #151E25, 1px bottom rule.

regions.name: leftColumn
regions.description: ~25% width stack: MAIN DRIVE CONTROL, TARGET ACOUSTIC INTELLIGENCE, LOFAR (NARROWBAND FREQUENCY), DEMON (PROPELLER SIGNATURE).

regions.name: centerColumn
regions.description: ~50% width: large tactical 3D sonar view (perspective grid, own-ship icon, green/cyan contact markers, circular compass top-right), WATER COLUMN depth gauge docked right, BTR (BEARING TIME RECORDER) below.

regions.name: rightColumn
regions.description: ~25% width stack: CONTACT REGISTRY (filter/sort + contact rows + PIN/ALIAS/RENAME + red CLEAR LOST CONTACTS), MANUAL SOLUTION (bearing/range/course/speed fields + SAVE SOLUTION), CAMPAIGN (selector, IN PROGRESS status, checklist), BROADBAND WATERFALL (AMBIENT).

keyElements.description: Large tactical 3D sonar view: near-black teal field #0A141A, perspective wireframe grid in dark teal, own-ship icon lower center, green #22D083 and cyan contact markers, pale target marker, circular compass/instrument upper-right, scanline + noise texture
Circular compass dial with pale cyan ticks + heading readout, upper-right of the tactical view
BTR bearing-time recorder: black plot field, repeated vertical green #03E877 + cyan event lines, time scale on top
LOFAR narrowband spectrogram: black field with grid markings, bright cyan noisy trace concentrated near the bottom
DEMON propeller-signature plot with amber #FACD78 and cyan traces, S1/S2/S3 markers, auto-analysis text in cyan/white/amber
CONTACT REGISTRY: compact bordered list rows, contact IDs + classification + bearing + range, action buttons
BROADBAND WATERFALL: dense blue-white #83DAFF vertical noise texture spectrogram
SONAR STATUS block: PASSIVE MODE + running mission timer, green/amber state pips
Full-page scanline overlay + dotted noise; panel interiors slightly lighter than the page canvas

reference.name: MAIN DRIVE CONTROL
reference.description: OWN SHIP RPM gauge + throttle slider + red ACTIVE PULSE (PING) action area

reference.name: TARGET ACOUSTIC INTELLIGENCE
reference.description: Target ID / range / velocity / bearing / confidence key-value readouts, dashes for empty values

reference.name: LOFAR (NARROWBAND FREQUENCY)
reference.description: Black spectrogram, cyan narrowband trace, freq/time grid

reference.name: DEMON (PROPELLER SIGNATURE)
reference.description: Amber+cyan waveform, blade markers, analysis text

reference.name: TACTICAL 3D SONAR VIEW
reference.description: Perspective 3D grid sonar scope with contact markers, own-ship icon, compass dial

reference.name: WATER COLUMN
reference.description: Vertical depth/profile plot with cyan+amber traces

reference.name: BTR (BEARING TIME RECORDER)
reference.description: Green/cyan vertical event lines over time

reference.name: CONTACT REGISTRY
reference.description: Contact rows with ID/class/bearing/range + row actions

reference.name: SONAR STATUS
reference.description: PASSIVE MODE + mission timer status rows

matches.note: cpu gauges -> RPM-style gauge + throttle readout, keeps usePanel metrics
info key-values -> target intelligence readouts from panel data
process list -> contact registry rows styled as classified contacts
network status -> sonar status (PASSIVE MODE, timer, state pips)
traffic graph -> blue-white broadband waterfall fed by traffic data

featured.name: TACTICAL SONAR
featured.description: Replaces the WORLD VIEW globe: perspective-ring sonar scope with rotating bearing sweep, teal-green/cyan contact markers, own-ship icon, compass ring, scanline texture — the reference's signature widget.
